approved_principle: Unseen examples of known tasks may share reviewed generic instructions; source content and substantive examples remain isolated.
entry_approval: Pending user review; the policy principle does not activate individual exemptions.

span_contract.encoding: UTF-8, no BOM, literal LF, no normalization before verification
span_contract.coordinates: Half-open byte and Unicode-scalar offsets in rendered user content before QwenChat wrapping
span_contract.matching: Require source revision, adapter digest, exact text digest and structural boundary to match; do not search and replace text inside payloads.
span_contract.token_rule: Only matches wholly inside approved spans can receive a generic-only disposition; a token or match crossing a payload boundary is not exempt.
span_contract.raw_evidence: Retain original text, full-content matches, content-only matches, offsets, decision and reviewer.
span_contract.model_inputs: Keep all registry text in actual inputs and natural token-length measurements.
span_contract.transport: Existing QwenChat transport handling is unchanged; embedded ChatML controls in source content remain quarantined.
span_contract.unknown_text: Unlisted instructions, examples, schemas and paraphrases remain unexempted. A registry revision requires review before row selection.

sources.input_rule: Use record.prompt unchanged; check its consistency with the first user message. Do not include assistant turns.
sources.reason: No separately authored adapter instruction exists. Natural user instructions and quoted material are payload, not automatically generic.

entries.rationale: The adapter delimiter identifies a file field but supplies no filename, code, commit intent or solution. All of those remain payload.
A field heading carries no article, passage, fact or answer. Context bytes remain fully subject to isolation.
Only the adapter-inserted heading qualifies. Question wording, instantiated problem templates and identical strings inside the context remain payload.

sources.input_rule: Registered prefix + newline-joined sentences, with source sentence tokens joined by one space; no gold entities or relations in the prompt

entries.text: Extract the entities and their relations from this document.
entries.rationale: The request names the known task without supplying any entity, relation instance, evidence sentence or demonstration. All source sentences and audit-only annotations retain their isolation obligations.
